lines.text: "reason": "FAIL: all30 archived market raw source paths fail presence/hash proof. Diagnostic dated archive rows alone cannot prove required market data loaded into this exact release. No fetch or fabricated prices.",

currentRule: Required market data loaded: current workflow §25 loads market data during initialization; §8 requires temporal semantics/provenance, valid price and explicit conflict/adjustment treatment. Current acceptance requires replayable market evidence in the exact release.
problem: Provider/schema/replay capability and presence of a usable price set are coupled to initialization acceptance. Neither an adapter function nor normalized rows alone proves raw-source replay.
findingOnIntent: Current contract enforces B (market data loaded at initialization), not merely A (capability). It never establishes permanent freshness of that loaded snapshot. Moving to capability is a contract change, not a textual reinterpretation.
proposedRule: DI4-vNext: approved market source/identity/field/unit contracts and an independently reviewed ingestion→normalization→retention→snapshot→replay capability certificate using retained, dated real-source evidence (may be historical) plus deterministic negative tests. Analysis gate separately requires complete accepted market observations for the declared request scope.
whySafer: Real-source capability remains auditable without requiring daily prices to keep initialization approved; no artificial empty MARKET reference or mock-only provider approval.
whenItFails: Unapproved source/schema/price meaning or unverified security identity
Only normalized/manual numbers with no permitted raw-source evidence or qualified replay equivalent
No real source qualification even if synthetic parser tests pass

INITIALIZATION_TIME: Source approval, schema and retention/replay capability qualification
Explicit supported coverage and use-case matrix
ANALYSIS_TIME: Requested observation coverage and accepted source-bound immutable market snapshot
DECISION_TIME: Revalidate market eligibility and references before publication/new capital
